transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess I'm here because... well, I was trying to eat cleaner, you know? I'm up for the lieutenant track at the firehouse, so I wanted to get in better shape. But... it kind of got away from me. I've been cutting back a lot. Like, just black coffee, maybe a protein shake, and a really small dinner. Even on shift days, when I'm working hard and I know I'm burning way more than that. It's just... yeah. That's what's going on.
Have you ever found yourself eating large amounts of food in a short period, even when you're not hungry?
No. I don't... no. It's really just the opposite. I don't eat much at all.
Do you find yourself really focused on your weight or the shape of your body a lot of the time?

Yeah... I guess so. Mostly just before a shift. I'll look in the mirror and... I don't know, I just check if my waist and my face look sharp enough. If they don't... it just kind of messes with my head. Makes me feel less confident, or... less command-ready for the day, I guess.
Is your decision to eat very little mainly driven by a fear of gaining weight or a desire to be thinner?

Yeah, I guess so. It's just... if I step on the scale and it's up even a pound—like after a big meal at the station or just drinking extra water—I get this... tight feeling. Like a panic, almost. I just think I've blown it, and the guys are gonna see me as soft or... out of control. So, yeah. I try to avoid that.
Do you think your body looks thinner than it actually is, or do you feel like you need to lose weight even when others might see you as being at a healthy weight?

I don't know about thinner than I am... I just know my gear and my station clothes, they hang pretty loose on me now. They did a fitness review at the department recently, and the doc there flagged my weight. Said it was too low for my height and build. But... I don't know, even hearing that, part of me still feels like I should probably trim down just a little bit more.
Even though your clothes are hanging loose and the department doctor mentioned your weight was low, do you still feel that you need to lose more weight to look the way you want?
I mean... yeah. I guess I do. It just doesn't feel like enough yet.
